reads.why: The gloss is the refinement-in-taste sense (polite society), but 'conduct anyone can manage' describes the ordinary-courtesy sense of polite.
reads.repair: Not courtesy but cultivation - the refinement a whole circle credits itself with.

reads.why: What a modern reader will hear first is a frequency claim about readers that we have no corpus to check.
reads.repair: Dated - grime so thick it has worked into the thing itself.

reads.why: Calling the moral sense 'a separate and much older word' is a provenance claim we cannot verify.
reads.repair: Technical of metals - a grading judgement, not a moral one.

reads.why: 'About a single act more often than a character' is a distribution claim about the word's typical target, the same shape as 'used mostly of the elderly'.
reads.repair: The adverb of *high-handed*: a decision taken over someone's head, with no thought of asking.

reads.why: This gloss is only the carefree-happy sense; 'a failure to take something seriously' belongs to blithe's separate heedless sense, and the neutral reading follows from that import.
reads.repair: Sunny and unburdened - a lightness of spirit meant kindly.

reads.why: 'Bad; unfortunate' is the lamentable sense (a deplorable state of finances); 'formal censure' describes deplorable's separate reprehensible-conduct sense.
reads.repair: Formal sorrow at a state of things - lamented rather than blamed.

reads.why: The gloss is the poor-quality/flimsy sense, but the note restricts the word to the separate metallic-sound sense.
reads.repair: Cheapness of material - flimsy, as if pressed from thin metal.

reads.why: OEWN glosses wail 'cry weakly or softly' (the whimper synset), which does not fit the word - and the note, correctly describing loud grief, contradicts the gloss above it.
'Used more comfortably of things than of people' is a claim about speaker usage patterns we have no corpus to support.
reads.repair: Offends the eye - and lands harder on a person than on a thing.

reads.why: 'About texture originally' is an origin story, which the rubric rules out as provenance.
reads.repair: Rough-grained manners - it suggests a person left unfinished.

reads.why: The erosion sense is neutral-technical ('aged rocks' disparages nothing), so a negative charge contradicts the gloss; the note itself is fine.
reads.repair: The geological sense - a landscape at an advanced stage of erosion.
